pageCarrieres.title: Careers
pageCarrieres.intro: Adullam is building a team to connect Africa with manufacturers worldwide. No position is published at the moment, but we read every application.

sections.title: Areas we are interested in
items: Software development, web and mobile.
Customer service and buyer relations.
Logistics and export coordination.
Sourcing and supplier relations.

sections.title: Unsolicited application
paragraphs: Send your CV and a few lines about your background to contact@adullamarket.com, with the subject "Application" and the area you are interested in. We review every application and reply if your profile matches a need.

pageCookies.title: Cookies and trackers
pageCookies.intro: A cookie is a small file saved on your device. We also use the browser's local storage, which plays an equivalent role. Here is everything the site uses.

sections.title: Essential to operation
items: Login: authentication token that keeps your session open.
Cart and delivery mode: kept on your device.
Language and country: remember your display and currency choice.
Light or dark theme.
Session identifier (24 hours at most): links your visits for the cart, recommendations and the Adu assistant.

sections.title: Comfort of use
items: Adu assistant: conversation identifier so you can find your discussion again.
Photo search: result kept temporarily during the session.
Start screen: remembers it was shown during the session.

sections.title: Audience measurement
paragraphs: Vercel Analytics (Vercel Inc.): page views and site performance, in aggregated form.

sections.title: Advertising
paragraphs: Meta Pixel (Meta Platforms): records your visits and certain actions (page view, add to cart, start of payment, purchase) to measure and improve our ads on Facebook and Instagram. This data is sent to Meta.

sections.title: Managing your choices
items: Browser: block or delete cookies and local storage in its settings. Some features, such as login and the cart, will stop working.
Advertising: manage your preferences in the ad settings of your Facebook or Instagram account.
A question: contact@adullamarket.com.

pageConfidentialite.title: Privacy Policy
pageConfidentialite.intro: This policy explains what data Adullam Global collects, why, who it is shared with and how to exercise your rights. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: Adullam Global, a company currently being incorporated in the United States, is responsible for processing your data. For any question or request: contact@adullamarket.com.

sections.title: Data we collect
items: Account: name, email address, password (never stored in plain text), language and country.
Orders and delivery: products ordered, delivery address, recipient phone number, order history.
Payment: payment status and amount. Card and Mobile Money details are entered with our payment provider, not with us.
Sourcing requests and messages: the content you send us, including attached photos and files.
Adu assistant and photo search: your messages and the images you send.
Cart and favourites.
Technical data: device and browser type, pages viewed, session identifier, IP address.

sections.title: Why we use this data
paragraphs: Legal basis: performance of the contract for orders, our legitimate interest in security and improving the service, and your consent where the law requires it.
items: Fulfil your order: payment, shipping, delivery.
Manage your account and send you emails about your orders.
Answer your sourcing requests and customer service questions.
Suggest suitable products through our recommendation systems.
Measure site audience and the effectiveness of our advertising.
Prevent fraud and secure the platform.

sections.title: Who we share your data with
paragraphs: We share data only when necessary:
items: Payment: our payment provider (GeniusPay) processes your Mobile Money or card payment.
Delivery: freight forwarders and carriers receive the recipient's name, address and phone number.
Email: Resend sends our confirmation and service emails.
Hosting: Hetzner (Germany) hosts our servers, Vercel (United States) hosts the website.
Advertising and audience: Meta (Meta Pixel) and Vercel Analytics, see the [Cookies](/cookies) page.
Artificial intelligence: language and image processing providers help us with the Adu assistant, translation and photo search.

sections.title: International transfers
paragraphs: Your data may be processed outside your country, notably in Germany and the United States. We choose providers that apply appropriate security measures.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: We keep your data while your account is active, then for as long as needed to meet our legal and accounting obligations and handle any disputes. You can ask for your account to be deleted at any time.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Encrypted connections (HTTPS), passwords never stored in plain text, data access limited to those who need it. No system is infallible: if a data breach affects you, we will inform you as required by applicable law.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can request access to, correction, deletion or export of your data, object to certain processing and withdraw your consent. Write to contact@adullamarket.com from your account email address. We reply within one month at most.

sections.title: Cookies and trackers
paragraphs: The full list of what the site uses is on the [Cookies](/cookies) page.

sections.title: Minors
paragraphs: The service is intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect data about minors.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: We update this policy if our practices change. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: We take care to keep published information accurate, but errors may remain. We do not control the third-party sites the website may link to.

sections.title: Personal data and cookies
paragraphs: See the [privacy policy](/confidentialite) and the [Cookies](/cookies) page.

pageRetours.title: Returns and refunds
pageRetours.intro: Here is what is covered, what is not, and how to request a refund.

sections.title: What is covered
paragraphs: Full refund of the price of the products and the delivery costs if your order is not shipped or does not reach its destination.

sections.title: How to request a refund
items: Write to contact@adullamarket.com with your order number, subject "Refund".
We check the situation with the carrier and the supplier, and reply within 24 business hours.
If non-delivery is confirmed, the refund is made to the payment method used, within 14 days.

sections.title: Damaged product or different from the order
paragraphs: Write to us within 7 days of receipt, with photos of the product and the parcel. We review each case with the supplier and propose a solution.

sections.title: What is not covered
items: Change of mind: products are ordered on request from manufacturers abroad and are not taken back.
An incorrect delivery address or phone number supplied by the buyer.

sections.title: See also
paragraphs: The [terms and conditions of sale](/cgv).

pageAbout.title: About us
pageAbout.intro: Adullamarket lets buyers in Africa order directly from factories, with no middlemen, local payment and delivery to their door.

sections.title: What we do
items: We list products from manufacturers in China, Turkey, Dubai and the United States.
We handle your order with the supplier and organise international transport.
You pay by Mobile Money or card, in your local currency (42 currencies).
We deliver to your country and you track the order from your account.
For a product you cannot find, our custom sourcing service looks for it on your behalf.

sections.title: Who it is for
paragraphs: Entrepreneurs, traders and individuals, first in Cameroon, Mali and Burkina Faso, and more widely across Africa. The website and the app are available in French, English, Portuguese and Arabic.

sections.title: Our commitments
items: Clearly displayed prices, with delivery costs included at payment.
A refund guarantee if the order is not delivered.
The transport mode and estimated lead time shown before you pay.
One contact, contact@adullamarket.com, with a reply within 24 business hours.

sections.title: Our technology
paragraphs: Adullam relies on photo search, a shopping assistant (Adu) and a recommendation system to help you find and order faster.

sections.title: Adullam Global
paragraphs: Adullamarket is published by Adullam Global, a company currently being incorporated in the United States. See the [legal notice](/mentions-legales).

pageCgv.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale
pageCgv.intro: These terms and conditions of sale (T&C) govern every order placed on adullamarket.com and in the Adullam mobile app. By placing an order, you accept them.

sections.title: Publisher and legal status
paragraphs: The website and the app are published by Adullam Global, a company currently being incorporated in the United States. Until incorporation is completed, the registration number and official address are not published. They will be added to this page and to the [legal notice](/mentions-legales) as soon as they are available.
Contact: contact@adullamarket.com

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Adullamarket is a marketplace that connects buyers, mainly in Africa, with manufacturers and suppliers in China, Turkey, Dubai and the United States, among others. Adullam Global handles the order with the supplier, the payment, international transport and delivery on your behalf.

sections.title: Products and sourcing requests
paragraphs: Each product page shows the price, specifications, the minimum order quantity when there is one, and the available variants. Photos are indicative. If a product is no longer available after your order, we tell you and refund you in full (article 8).
For a product that is not in the catalogue, you can send a sourcing request. We reply with an offer: the order is binding only once the offer is accepted and paid.

sections.title: Prices and currencies
paragraphs: Prices are set in US dollars (USD). They are displayed in your local currency for information, based on a conversion rate maintained by Adullam. The exact amount to pay, in local currency, is shown before you confirm payment. Prices may change: the applicable price is the one displayed when you place the order.

sections.title: Delivery costs
paragraphs: Delivery costs are calculated from the weight and volume of the products, the transport mode chosen and the destination country. They are shown in the cart and at payment, and are included in the total to pay. No extra amount is requested on delivery.
If you choose door-to-door delivery, it is charged only once for the whole cart.

sections.title: Order and payment
paragraphs: The order is binding once payment is confirmed. Payment is made by Mobile Money or bank card, through our payment provider. Adullam does not store your card data or Mobile Money credentials.
You receive a confirmation email with your order number, then an email at each status change. We may cancel an order in case of suspected fraud or an obvious pricing error, with a full refund.

sections.title: Transport modes and lead times
paragraphs: Three transport modes are offered depending on the product and the country: sea, air and express. The estimated lead time of each mode is shown before payment. These are estimates: they start when payment is confirmed and may be extended by customs checks, weather or events beyond our control.
items: Sea: lowest cost, longest lead time, suited to heavy or bulky parcels.
Air: faster, higher cost.
Express: fastest, for small parcels.

sections.title: Refund guarantee
paragraphs: You are refunded in full if your order is not shipped or does not reach its destination.
items: An order is considered undelivered if it has not arrived by the maximum lead time shown at payment, or if it can no longer be shipped.
To request a refund, write to contact@adullamarket.com with your order number.
The refund is made to the payment method used, within 14 days after non-delivery is confirmed.
The guarantee covers the price of the products and the delivery costs paid.

sections.title: Returns and change of mind
paragraphs: Products are ordered on request from manufacturers abroad, so returns for a simple change of mind are not accepted. If you receive a damaged product or one that differs from your order, write to us within 7 days of receipt with photos and your order number: we review each case with the supplier. See also the [Returns and refunds](/retours) page.

sections.title: Receiving your parcel
paragraphs: Check the condition of the parcel on receipt and report any problem within 7 days. You must provide an accurate delivery address and recipient phone number: a parcel returned because of incorrect details may lead to re-shipping costs.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: Adullam Global is responsible for the proper handling of the order, from payment to delivery. To the extent permitted by law, its liability does not cover delays or damage caused by force majeure, a carrier, customs authorities or incorrect information supplied by the buyer. Nothing in these T&C limits the mandatory rights that the law of your country gives you.

sections.title: Personal data
paragraphs: Your data is processed in line with our [privacy policy](/confidentialite).

sections.title: Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: If there is a problem, contact us first at contact@adullamarket.com: we look for an amicable solution. Failing that, these T&C are governed by the law of the US state in which Adullam Global is incorporated, without depriving consumers of the mandatory protection of the law of their country of residence. This clause will be specified once incorporation is complete.

sections.title: Changes to these T&C
paragraphs: We may change these T&C. The version that applies to an order is the one in force on the day it is placed. The update date is shown at the top of the page.
